site.name: VICTORIA / BRITISH COLUMBIA
site.desc: PHAC confirmed one positive hantavirus case among four Canadian Hondius returnees (AP News, 17 May): Yukon resident in their 70s hospitalized in Victoria with fever and headache, marking the 10th confirmed case linked to the outbreak. Confirmatory PCR sent to National Microbiology Lab Winnipeg; partner tested negative. Dr. Bonnie Henry reassured no increased risk to general public.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: Two Americans transported to National Quarantine Center at UNMC in biocontainment units; one who tested mildly positive was cleared of virus per AP 15 May. 15 additional passengers quarantined at NQU including content creator Jake Rosmarin. Dr. Stephen Kornfeld (Oregon) released 14 May after inconclusive swabs resolved negative; CDC confirmed no further US cases as of 17 May and risk to American public remains extremely low per CDC 14 May update.

site.name: WELLINGTON
site.desc: One NZ national arrived at Bullsbrook quarantine facility near Perth, Australia for mandatory three-week quarantine per AP 16 May, traveling alongside five Australians on RAAF Base Pearce intake flight; all tested negative before departure. NZ Ministry of Health coordinating contact tracing; no symptomatic cases reported.

site.name: PERTH / BULLSBROOK / SYDNEY
site.desc: Five Australians and one New Zealander arrived at RAAF Base Pearce near Perth 16 May and transported to Bullsbrook quarantine facility for mandatory three-week quarantine per AP 16 May; all tested negative before departure. Health Minister Mark Butler enacted one of the world's strictest quarantine responses citing 42-day incubation risk; facility largely unused since COVID-19 pandemic.
